name: temp-core-startup
description: Transient startup and brownout-restart check of design/temp_core.sch: cold start from 0 V with EN gated by POR, pre-enable quiescent draw, and identical settling after a rail collapse (proves the DVBE loop has no reachable dead state). POST-LAYOUT SIBLING (issue #83, part of #18): identical to sim/temp-core-startup/testbench/tb.json except that 'netlist' names the fragment sim/build_tb.py assembles from layout/postlayout/temp_core.spice instead of design/netlist/temp_core.spice. The stimulus is shared with the schematic sibling (same DUT ports), and that sibling's manifest, fragment and records are untouched.
claim: POST-LAYOUT RE-RUN (issue #83, part of #18) of the schematic-level record 20260801-073944-8b7e57f in sim/temp-core-startup/records/, same stimulus and same checks, DUT swapped from design/netlist/temp_core.spice to layout/postlayout/temp_core.spice. Any check that flips from PASS on that record to FAIL here is a REGRESSION to flag and route to its owning design issue, not to absorb -- the schematic-vs-extracted comparison is generated by sim/postlayout_delta.py into the paired <record-id>-postlayout-delta derived record. The original claim, unchanged, follows. --- Designer-level startup check for the temp-sensing core (issue #9). Substantiates DR-005 startup ordering step 6 (the sensor's enable is gated by POR's output and is never required to be valid before POR) and the freedom-from-degenerate-state property the PTAT/CTAT transfer records in sim/temp-core-designer-check/ implicitly assume. Deterministic corners only -- mismatch between the detector's replica leg and the mirror is issue #15's Monte Carlo job.
netlist_provenance_note: layout/postlayout/temp_core.spice's own header (layout/postlayout/AUDIT.md): 114 drawn devices (27 nfet_03v3, 28 pfet_03v3, 9 pnp_10p00x10p00, 50 ppolyf_u) with first-order interconnect R/C on 69/73 nets (138 parasitic cards, sigma R = 65734 ohm, sigma C = 1552.3 fF), net names restored through klt lvs's own 73/73 net correspondence. NOT from the layout: (a) 4 body/well/plate nets (NW1 -> VDD, NW2 -> NT, NWQ -> VSS, vsubs -> VSS) tied to the net the SCHEMATIC puts them on -- the extraction deck's connectivity stack does not reach an Nwell, a substrate ring or a bipolar base well, so they extract isolated and would otherwise float; (b) XCC (cap_mim_2f0_m3m4_noshield, 12u x 12u on PG/NZ) is NOT DRAWN -- reserved floor area -- and is spliced in ideal, so anything in this record that turns on the amplifier's compensation pole is a schematic claim, not a post-layout one. Everything else -- MOS, vertical PNP and poly resistor bodies alike -- is a real extraction of drawn geometry, and this cell needs none of the device-model substitutions AUDIT.md records for the cells that use ppolyf_u_1k or MiM caps.
analyses: meas tran vpre find v(ptat) at=1.4m
meas tran ipre find i(vsup) at=1.4m
meas tran ibpre find i(vib) at=1.4m
meas tran ibdpre find i(vibd) at=1.4m
meas tran vibpre find v(ibias) at=1.4m
meas tran vrun1 find v(ptat) at=2.4m
meas tran irun1 find i(vsup) at=2.4m
meas tran vcrun1 find v(ctat) at=2.4m
meas tran vrun2 find v(ptat) at=4.9m
meas tran vcrun2 find v(ctat) at=4.9m
meas tran tcross when v(ptat)=0.5 rise=1 td=1.5m

vptat_run1.description: cold-start settled PTAT; the spread floor proves .temp applied (a PTAT output that does not move with temperature is broken, not perfect) and that every point really did start

vctat_run1.description: cold-start settled CTAT = VEB of XQ1

restart_err_ppm.description: PTAT after the brownout restart vs. after the cold start. The load-bearing check: a loop that can latch into its degenerate state does it here, and this number goes to -1e6, not to tens of ppm

ctat_restart_err_ppm.description: same restart comparison on the CTAT output

vptat_pre_mv.description: pre-POR window (EN low, rail up): PTAT pad held at VSS, not floating

iq_pre_own_ua.description: pre-POR window: what the cell draws from its OWN VDD pin before POR releases it (DR-005 step 6), i.e. i(vsup) minus the IBIAS reference metered by vib

iq_pre_pin_ua.description: pre-POR draw seen at the rail, including bias_core's 0.5 uA reference. Since DR-010 that reference is no longer thrown into a clamp inside this cell: it lands in xmsh, the stand-in for the rest of the shared net, and in the assembled block it reaches por_comparator and por_output_chain instead -- i.e. it is spent on the POR decision rather than wasted. Still not this cell's current; recorded here so #11/#14 budget the shared-IBIAS interface (DR-005) against the block Iq rather than rediscovering it

ibias_pre_dis_na.description: THE DR-010 INVARIANT, through the cold start. Current the DISABLED cell takes out of the shared IBIAS node in the pre-POR window, metered by vibd. It used to be the whole reference, shorted to VSS through an ENB-gated XMDIB, which starved por_comparator's tail mirror and made RESETn unreleasable. Bounded at 25 nA = 5 % of the 0.5 uA IBIAS convention. Requirement, not observation

vibias_pre_v.description: the shared node in the same window: still at a diode drop with a disabled temp_core hanging on it, because xmsh (por_output_chain's always-on XMBD) defines it and this cell no longer drags it to VSS

iq_run_ua.description: <20 uA block target, running, including the 0.5 uA IBIAS reference pushed into the pin

start_us.description: time from EN release to PTAT crossing 0.5 V; bounded so a 'starts eventually' corner is a failure, not a pass
